summary: Build resilience, adaptability, and career agility with practical tools, exercises, and a 12-month action plan. Enroll today.
lede: Adaptability and resilience training helps professionals, including team leaders and project managers, assess stress responses and respond to workplace change. It covers scenario mapping, decision tools such as the Cynefin Framework and OODA Loop, energy management, and clear communication through uncertainty. Participants also create a personal resilience toolkit and a 12-month career agility roadmap for navigating shifting priorities and role changes.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to stay effective while change keeps moving around them. It is especially relevant if you manage people, coordinate work, support learning, or need a more structured way to handle uncertainty and career movement.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, a recent example of workplace change, and one current challenge that affects your delivery, team coordination, or career planning. You will use worksheets, templates, and guided exercises, so no coding or pre-installation is required.
